description: Answer checks for one website: whether search-backed assistants (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini) name or cite the site and up to 3 rivals for its buyer questions, this week and the 8 before. Each question is asked 3 times a week per assistant (checks has one row per run). position ranks the site among the tracked brands an answer names (only the site and its rivals count). voice has per-assistant, per-week counts for the site (rival_id null) and each rival. An input, not a score. locked=true means the plan does not run checks.

website_id.description: website id (uuid) or the site domain (example.com); omit when the account has one website

name: answer_checks
title: AI answer checks
